guide.title: Deckard Cain's Overview
guide.text:
Deckard is a Healer specialized in single-target healing,
with the possibility to prepare Healing Potion on the ground for later usage,
and crowd control, usually used as follow-up
to your Tank's engage.

guide.title: Deckard Cain's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Strong and efficient single-target healing output
Powerful area of effect crowd control
Access to Emerald for healing reduction
Weaknesses
Weak against burst damage
No access to Cleanse or similar tools to remove crowd-control effects
Struggles when facing high-mobility Heroes
Unable to provide Unstoppable frames

guide.title: Deckard Cain's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Deckard Cain synergizes with
Scroll Of Sealing makes Deckard excellent at following up on
Heroes that can provide their own source of reliable crowd control
(for example Johanna) and similarly good at setting up enemy Heroes
for allied skillshot-based Abilities (such as Kel'Thuzad).
Healing Potion is extremely easy to use for healing allied Heroes
without mobility, so they are great to have on Deckard's side.
For the same reason, you should avoid picking high-mobility Heroes
and/or dive Heroes.
Deckard Cain is countered by
With little in the way of mobility,
Deckard struggles against Heroes who can easily engage on him,
especially if they are ranged.
Heroes who have access to Unstoppable effects
have easy life against Deckard as they can ignore all his offensive Abilities.
Similarly, Cleanse effects (for example Intercession
by Whitemane) are good against Deckard
because they basically deny his main strength: crowd control.
Deckard can make up for his weakness to burst damage
by taking short fights, however, the enemy team will usually still have an edge during them.

guide.title: Deckard Cain's Maps
guide.text:
Deckard Cain's stronger maps
Deckard Cain's average maps
Deckard Cain's weaker maps
Deckard tends to do well on Maps that feature many choke points,
where he is able to get value from Scroll Of Sealing
and his Heroic Ability: Stay Awhile and Listen
or Lorenado. Battlegrounds with a lot of
wide areas (such as Hanamura Temple)
will obviously make this characteristic harder to exploit.
The way Healing Potion works
is particularly good when contesting powerful Objectives
that take a long time to be secured (for example
Shrines on Infernal Shrines).
Having to move too much on the battlefield means
you will get less value out of the potion-stocking aspect.

guide.title: Deckard Cain's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Use Healing Potion to place some Healing Potions in lane, near the next Objective, or wherever you think the next team fight is going to happen.
Horadric Cube has a short flight time, but can still hit enemies running directly away from Deckard if the targeting reticle is centered.
Due to its slow animation, Scroll Of Sealing should be used after any crowd control effect.
Use Stay Awhile and Listen from a safe position or from where the enemy team cannot see you (ideally from behind impassable-terrain).
Lorenado can be used for peeling, to contest a Capture Point, or to prevent enemy Heroes from escaping.
Activate Sapphire at Level 1 to engage for your team and/or as a setup for Scroll Of Sealing.
Activate Ruby at Level 4 to spawn multiple Lesser Healing Potions for melee Heroes a few seconds before they will need healing.
Activate Emerald at Level 7 to immediately apply a healing reduction debuff on the enemy Hero that your team is trying to kill.
Activate Ancient Blessings at Level 13 whenever a team fight starts, to boost your team's damage and indirectly increase your healing output.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Deckard Cain's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Deckard's multiple crowd control Abilities give
him a niche as a Healer
who thrives in aggressive team compositions that have the ability
to follow up with heavy loads of burst damage,
especially if accompanied by Heroes who can setup for him.
Deckard's only healing Ability, Healing Potion,
has the unique ability to be thrown on the ground instead of being only usable
on Heroes, allowing allied Heroes to pick them whenever they want.
Being able to set up some of them ahead of time is useful to mitigate
his weakness against burst damage.

abilities.title: Healing Potion
abilities.text:
Healing Potion
(Q)
Deckard Cain
Mana: 25
Cooldown: 4 seconds
Throw a Healing Potion on the ground that heals the first allied Hero that comes in contact with it for 285 (+4% per level).
Limit 5 active Potions.
Although its healing amount is not particularly high when compared to other main
healing Abilities, Healing Potion has one of the shortest cooldowns and lowest
Mana costs of any Ability; its sustain single-target output and efficiency are
unmatched by other Healers. This has the implication of making Deckard or
allies difficult to take down without the help of burst damage while they are
actively being healed.
Healing Potion's most notable property lies in the fact they can stay unused on the ground,
which warrants a short explanation. Throwing a Healing Potion towards an area
not currently occupied by an allied Hero who lacks Health leaves the thrown Healing Potion behind to be
picked up, instantly healing and applying any Talent-related effects to any
allied Hero, including Deckard, who moves over the Potion. This means that
several Healing Potions can be left on the ground (up to five) for future use. This
helps Deckard deal with burst damage somewhat, as a few Healing Potions can heal all but
the most severe of wounds, as long as several Healing Potions have been set up ahead of
time and in a way that they that they cannot be picked up by accident. This
feature also gives Deckard the unique ability to heal distant allies (such as
Heroes in different lanes) by setting up a few Healing Potions to be picked up at the
teammate's leisure. This is also why Healing Potion often ends up being—and
should almost always be—used on cooldown before impending team fights.
Healing Potion can be difficult to use in combat.
With its short flight time, Healing Potion can heal an unintended
target or miss outright, and particularly when dealing with moving Heroes or
while under pressure. Becoming familiar with Healing Potion's flight time through sheer
practice is therefore important for aspiring Deckard players.
Note that holding [Alt] while casting Healing Potion will throw a Healing Potion directly onto
Deckard for instant healing, however, allied Heroes overlapping with Deckard
may still pick up that Healing Potion before he does. So, when you intend to heal yourself
while surrounded by allied Heroes who are not full Health, you should position far away from them
to ensure the Healing Potion does not get accidentally picked up by them right after it spawns.
While under the effects of Fortitude of the Faithful,
the cooldown of Healing Potion gets reduced from 4 to about 2.7 seconds.
This means that Deckard should ideally be close to allied Heroes for being able
to place Healing Potions on the ground at a higher frequency, making it faster
to set up Healing Potions for later usage or increasing his healing output.

abilities.title: Horadric Cube
abilities.text:
Horadric Cube
(W)
Deckard Cain
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Release the Horadric Cube. After 0.5 seconds it explodes, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds.
Horadric Cube's main purpose is to set up for Scroll Of Sealing,
thanks to it relatively powerful Slow effect. Although Horadric Cube has a
short flight time, its fair area of effect should allow you to hit your
intended targets if you center the Ability's targeting reticle properly.
Otherwise, the Slow effect is also useful as a general mean of peeling
or following up. The Level 7 Kanai's Cube Talent is notable for
turning Horadric Cube into a powerful damage mitigation tool and changing the
way it should be used somewhat to reduce incoming burst damage.
While under the effects of Fortitude of the Faithful,
the cooldown of Horadric Cube gets reduced from 12 to 8 seconds.

abilities.title: Scroll Of Sealing
abilities.text:
Scroll Of Sealing
(E)
Deckard Cain
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Unfurl an enchanted scroll over 2.25 seconds, forming a triangle that deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies inside and Roots them for 1.5 seconds.
Scroll Of Sealing's long triggering period makes it difficult to outright
land on targets that are actively looking out for it. There are still
several ways of making good use of the Ability. By targeting Scroll Of Sealing
in such a way that the area of effect is directly on top of an intended target
who has been Slowed by Horadric Cube,
you can greatly improve your chances of
hitting. Attacking or channeling foes may also be reluctant or
find themselves unable to leave the Ability's area of effect in time.
A good
tactic is also to cast Scroll Of Sealing in the path of a moving foe so that
they are either forced to walk into the area of effect or wait for it to expire,
blocking them off and fulfilling your purpose either way. Scroll Of Sealing's
main use, however, is simply as a follow-up tool: by using
the Ability against foes that have already been crowd controlled,
you can ensure successful hits and greatly improve your teammates' uptime.
As needed, it can also be used for waveclear, although it is not
particularly effective for this task, as is Deckard in general.
While under the effects of Fortitude of the Faithful,
the cooldown of Scroll Of Sealing gets reduced from 16 to about 10 seconds.

abilities.title: Stay Awile and Listen
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Stay Awhile and Listen
(R)
Deckard Cain
Heroic
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 70 seconds
After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.
Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.
Stay Awhile and Listen provides Deckard with a powerful but situational area
of effect crowd control effect. To get the most
value out of the Sleep effect, your team should ideally
deal damage to a single Hero and let the others Sleep. To avoid being
interrupted, use it from a safe position
or from where the enemy team cannot see you (ideally from behind
impassable-terrain)
and track enemy cooldowns to choose the appropriate moment.
Healers with powerful saving tools
(such as Auriel, Rehgar, and Uther)
are also important targets to consider as it prevents them from exploiting
important protection timings. In an uncoordinated environment, Stay Awhile and
Listen is more likely to be used as a defensive tool to peel melee
Heroes away from you or other fragile teammates.
Strong Stay Awhile and Listen's wide area of effect allows it to be a decent
way to set up a number of more difficult-to-hit Abilities
(for example Ring of Frost by Jaina).
It should be noted that, if they are not damaged, Sleeping targets will always
Sleep for at least 2
seconds after Stay Awhile and Listen is canceled by yourself or enemy
interrupts. Informing your teammates of your
intended targets and warning them not to damage said targets is a good way of
improving your success rate.

abilities.title: Lorenado
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Lorenado
(R)
Deckard Cain
Heroic
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Vector Targeting
After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.
Lorenado is a versatile but peculiar Ability which seeks to disrupt your
opponents' plan. Dealing almost no damage, its main use is preventing players
from moving where they may want to go, especially in tight corridors
and on Capture Points.
Lorenado can also be used to push enemies into Scroll Of Sealing
right before it goes off. By staying inside Lorenado, you can make yourself impossible
to approach for melee Heroes for its duration. As a consequence, you should immediately
drop it in the retreat direction when getting focused.
It is worth noting that Lorenado uses an uncommon targeting system known as
Vector Targeting. This means that Lorenado's rectangular area of effect does
not originate from the caster himself, unlike most Abilities,
but instead from a chosen point to another. This flexible targeting
system allows you to accurately control Lorenado's direction.

abilities.title: Fortitude of the Faithful
abilities.text:
Fortitude of the Faithful
(D)
Deckard Cain
Passive
When at least 1 other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains 10 Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge 50% faster.
Deckard's Trait makes him particularly teammate-reliant, even for a Healer.
Fortitude of the Faithful's allied requirement means that Deckard loses out on
what amounts to a 33% more Ability casts and a very decent 10 Armor increase.
Although Deckard's Abilities do not lend themselves well to spending much time
alone, Fortitude of the Faithful may as well read "stay with an allied Hero at all
times" because Deckard is tuned around this Ability's effects.

and Scroll of Stone Curse at Level 16 allows
you to deal a lot of damage to enemy Heroes who get caught inside
Scroll Of Sealing.
Cube Mastery at Level 7 lets you do that more often.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
?
Scroll of Identify
(Level 1)
Deckard Cain
Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2.
Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.
Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.
Scroll of Identify is a decent Quest-based Talent
which slightly increases the damage of Scroll Of Sealing
when hitting enemy Heroes with it. Unlock the first Reward
to reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit
and to Reveal them for a few seconds.
Unlock the second Reward to slightly empower the amount and duration
of the Armor reduction.
?
Field Study
(Level 1)
Deckard Cain
Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.
Field Study is a good Talent that provides Deckard with a
respectable healing power increase as well as a bit of offensive power,
particularly when combined with Scroll of Stone Curse at Level 16.
✔
Sapphire
(Level 1)
Deckard Cain
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%.
Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.
Sapphire is a strong Talent that can be activated
to make your next cast of Horadric Cube
apply a better Slow
and, like for any other Gem, deal double damage.
We recommend this Talent because it allows you to easily
engage or peel for your team
as well as connect Scroll Of Sealing.
Do not pick more than 2 Gems in the same Build. A second Gem is fine to have because
it gives you more flexibility and more opportunities to increase the damage done by
Horadric Cube. A third Gem is too much because, when using a Gem,
the other Gems do nothing whereas a different Talent would provide some benefits.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
✔
Potion of Shielding
(Level 4)
Deckard Cain
Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.
Potion of Shielding is a strong Talent
which provides a decent Shield to allied Heroes
healed by Healing Potion.
While it does not increase your sustain healing,
Potion of Shielding is still a powerful addition
to your kit as Deckard struggles against burst damage.
Shields generated by different instances of Healing Potion
do not stack, but only refresh the duration. As a consequence, you and allied Heroes
should ideally wait for the Shield to be almost destroyed or expired before
picking another Healing Potion, unless relatively low on Health.
?
Rejuvenation Potion
(Level 4)
Deckard Cain
Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds.
Rejuvenation Potion is a good Talent
that makes each Healing Potion
heal over time for a few seconds and restore Mana
to whoever picks them.
Consider going for this Talent when you want to further empower
your already good sustain healing,
something which is useful on Battlegrounds where the Objective
is powerful and takes a while to be contested (such as Braxis Holdout).
?
Ruby
(Level 4)
Deckard Cain
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.
Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.
Ruby is a good Talent
that can be activated to make your next Horadric Cube
generate 3 Lesser Healing Potions for each enemy Hero hit
and, like for any other Gem, deal double damage.
Contrary to Healing Potion,
they disappear after 10 seconds and heal for a bit less.
The way this Talent works make it more valuable when
your team has one or more diving Heroes
or when your team is trying to contest a Capture Point,
because in those situations it will be easier
for you to hit multiple Heroes with Horadric Cube
and for allied Heroes to collect Lesser Healing Potions.
The fact each Lesser Healing Potion spawns in a random location nearby
makes Ruby weak against crowd control
effects that can impair movement because it will be harder or even impossible to catch them.
Do not pick more than 2 Gems in the same Build. A second Gem is fine to have because
it gives you more flexibility and more opportunities to increase the damage done by
Horadric Cube. A third Gem is too much because, when using a Gem,
the other Gems do nothing whereas a different Talent would provide some benefits.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
?
Cube Mastery
(Level 7)
Deckard Cain
Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.
Cube Mastery is a decent Talent which
reduces cooldown and Mana cost of Scroll Of Sealing,
allowing you to Root enemy Heroes more often,
sometimes even in quick succession if you manage to hit enough enemy Heroes
with Horadric Cube.
The cooldown reduction provided has synergy with
Scroll of Identify at Level 1
because it can be helpful to stack the Quest faster
and with Scroll of Stone Curse at Level 16
because it can drastically increase your damage done,
especially if combined with Field Study at Level 1.
?
Kanai's Cube
(Level 7)
Deckard Cain
Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.
Kanai's Cube is a good Talent
that turns Horadric Cube into a defensive Ability,
allowing you to reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes hit.
We find this Talent particularly good when playing against Heroes
who can deal high but predictable damage in a short time frame
(for example The Butcher).
Even if not a Gem, this Talent can be combined with
Perfect Gems at Level 20
to constantly reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes
during team fights, with about 80% uptime.
✔
Emerald
(Level 7)
Deckard Cain
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by 75% for 4 seconds.
Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.
Emerald is a strong Talent
that can be activated to make your next Horadric Cube
drastically reduce the healing received by enemy Heroes hit
and, like for any other Gem, deal double damage.
The healing reduction provided by this Talent
is great on a Hero like Deckard because he has access to
crowd control which
can be used to lock down enemy Heroes for your team
to burst damage them
while the enemy Healer cannot do much.
Do not pick more than 2 Gems in the same Build. A second Gem is fine to have because
it gives you more flexibility and more opportunities to increase the damage done by
Horadric Cube. A third Gem is too much because, when using a Gem,
the other Gems do nothing whereas a different Talent would provide some benefits.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Stay Awhile and Listen
(Level 10)
Deckard Cain
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 70 seconds
After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.
Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.
Stay Awhile and Listen is a strong Heroic Ability
which can be picked in most if not all situations, however,
it has clear weaknesses you have to play around when facing Heroes
who have access to interrupts,
Unstoppable effects,
and/or mobility tools.
?
Lorenado
(Level 10)
Deckard Cain
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Vector Targeting
After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.
Lorenado is a good Heroic Ability
that you can use to peel from melee Heroes,
to push enemy Heroes inside Scroll Of Sealing,
or to contest a Capture Point—this last point makes it valuable
on Battlegrounds with a Boss Camp.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
?
Super Healing Potion
(Level 13)
Deckard Cain
If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more.
Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.
Super Healing Potion is a good Talent
that empowers Healing Potion in two ways:
increases by 25% their healing when used by allied Heroes below 50% Health
and doubles their healing after staying on the ground for 2 seconds.
The delayed effect is particularly effective on Battlegrounds
where the Objective is stationary and powerful, allowing you
and your team to get there a dozen of seconds before it starts
to safely cast Healing Potion multiple times
in the area and prepare them for later use.
You should pick this Talent when you need more sustain
healing (generally against team compositions featuring multiple
Healers or when playing ARAM). You can combine it
with Safety in Numbers at Level 16
to further increase your sustain healing.
Super Healing Potion has synergy with
Super Healing Potion at Level 13. When picked together,
any Healing Potion on the ground will refill
after 8 seconds and then become bigger after 2 more seconds.
?
Potion of Revival
(Level 13)
Deckard Cain
When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.
Potion of Revival is a decent Talent
which makes each Healing Potion heal for 75% value
all Heroes around the main target who gets 100% healing instead.
You may consider going for this Talent when your team features
a lot of melee Heroes and the enemy team has ways
to deal area of effect damage.
✔
Ancient Blessings
(Level 13)
Deckard Cain
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 damage in an area and heal for 90 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.
Ancient Blessings is a strong Talent that,
once every 45 seconds, can be used to boost allied Heroes for 8 seconds.
Heroes affected by this buff can deal additional damage in an area
with their Basic Attacks and heal themselves based on the number of Heroes hit.
This effect has an internal cooldown of 1 seconds,
so it has no synergy with Heroes who have high Attack Speed
and works just fine with most Heroes, unless they cannot really
expose to use Basic Attacks (notably Probius).

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
?
Scroll of Stone Curse
(Level 16)
Deckard Cain
Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.
Scroll of Stone Curse is a good Talent
which drastically increases the damage done by Scroll Of Sealing,
but only if you manage to hit multiple Heroes with it.
Due to how it works, we recommend combining it
with Sapphire at Level 1
and/or Stay Awhile and Listen,
unless you can rely on your Tank to hit
more than a single Hero with Scroll Of Sealing.
?
Safety in Numbers
(Level 16)
Deckard Cain
If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.
Safety in Numbers is a good Talent
which improves Fortitude of the Faithful
in various ways when there is more than one allied Hero within range:
further reduce the cooldown of your Basic Abilities,
give you more Armor,
and increase your Mana Regeneration.
You should pick this Talent when you need more sustain
healing (generally against team compositions featuring multiple
Healers or when playing ARAM). You can combine it
with Super Healing Potion at Level 13
to further increase your sustain healing.
✔
Horadric Staff
(Level 16)
Deckard Cain
Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.
Horadric Staff is a good Talent
that, once every 5 seconds, Stuns the next enemy Hero
you hit with a Basic Attack. You cannot toggle it, so be careful not to waste it
when you need it as a counter for a specific enemy Hero
(such as Sonya using Whirlwind).
When playing against melee Heroes who play aggressively,
you can use Horadric Staff to keep them
inside Scroll Of Sealing while it goes off.
Due to your short Attack Range, ranged
and/or high-mobility Heroes will not be
easy to catch with this, unless they misplay.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Deckard Cain
talent_pages.text:
✔
Respect the Elderly
(Level 20)
Deckard Cain
Stay Awhile and Listen Silences and Blinds enemies for 3 seconds upon waking up from Sleep.
Respect the Elderly is a strong Talent
which makes Stay Awhile and Listen apply
a long-lasting Silence and Blind
when its Sleep ends, gets removed, or is canceled by damage.
We recommend this Talent because it has huge playmaking potential in team fights,
something that is extremely valuable in the late game.
If it connects, the team fight will immediately shift in your team's favor.
?
Morenados!
(Level 20)
Deckard Cain
Lorenado gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds every time an enemy Hero is knocked back. This effect can only occur once per 0.5 seconds.
Morenados! is a good Talent that gives you
a second charge of Lorenado
and makes it reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds when hitting enemy Heroes.
This kind of Talent helps you to peel
for your team—especially in narrow areas—and to Knockback
enemy Heroes out of Capture Points (such as a game-ending Boss).
?
Bottomless Flask
(Level 20)
Deckard Cain
After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.
Bottomless Flask is a situational Talent that
changes the way you can use by making Healing Potion
refill after a few seconds. Even if empty, they still count for the cap
and thus get replaced when exceeding it.
This kind of effect increases your healing output during prolonged team fights
and is particularly effective when your team wants to control a given area,
even if your team decided to split for some reason and you are not there anymore.
Bottomless Flask has synergy with
Super Healing Potion at Level 13. When picked together,
any Healing Potion on the ground will refill
after 8 seconds and then become bigger after 2 more seconds.
?
Perfect Gems
(Level 20)
Deckard Cain
Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.
Perfect Gems is a situational Talent that allows you to use Gems
( Sapphire, Ruby, and Emerald)
as well as Horadric Cube more often.
A single Gem is enough to get value from Perfect Gems because,
after picking it, having more Gems will only increase your versatility
and not help to have a Gem ready every time that Horadric Cube is available.
In addition to Gems, Kanai's Cube has synergy with
Perfect Gems as well because it allows you to constantly
reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes, up to around 80% uptime.
